correctness.rationale: True order-two polyanalytic Fock space in one variable has simple rotation-character Hermite basis psi_0=bar(z), psi_n=(z^n bar(z)−n z^(n−1))/sqrt(n!), so radial bounded operators are diagonal with bounded coefficients a_n. Coherent-state Berezin evaluation equals e^(−x)[x F''+(1−2x)F'+xF], F=Σ a_n x^n/n!, including x=0. The null equation with F=e^x H reduces to xH''+H'+H=0, recurrence (j+1)² h_{j+1}=−h_j, hence a_n=c L_n(1), a unique compact nonzero bounded null operator. Classical Laguerre Plancherel–Rotach L_n(1)=(e^1/2/sqrt(pi))n^−1/4[cos(2sqrt n−pi/4)+O(n^−1/2)]. Joint equidistribution of n/M and phase 2sqrt n modulo 2pi gives N_D(t)~(3e²/(8pi²))t^−4 because average cos^4=3/8; monotone inversion gives k^1/4 s_k→(3e²/(8pi²))^1/4, S_p threshold p>4 for kernel element, and normalized fourth-power harmonic sum constant 3e²/(8pi²). Independently recalculated Laguerre recurrence through n=250000 and counting estimates t=.10,.07,.05 converging to normalized 0.99982,1.00017,1.00007. This supports but does not prove infinite equidistribution.
